brief: 069 the Fixer redone (Sky, 2026-10-27: 'Go'): Sky's final concept fixer_v7_cutout (intake pose) -> Tripo 3.1 -> the hybrid fit -> the static check. No animation until Sky's OK.
note: Sky's 'Go' 2026-10-27: one Tripo 3.1 take (about $0.60); a retry only for a call that fails at $0

model.note: Sky's pick for 3D (memory: Tripo 3.1, ~$0.60 via Runware). Runware's Tripo 3.1 page (https://runware.ai/docs/models/tripo-v3-1): inputs.images takes 1 to 4 images for multiview-to-3D, order not stated there; Tripo's own API orders multi-view as [front, left, back, right] with views omittable (front required, at least 2: https://developers.tripo3d.com/en/docs/generation-multiview-to-model/standard), so the three real views go in that order and no right view is invented. faceLimit 20000 is Runware's maximum for Tripo. pbr off: the game's figures are matte. orientation default: the fit normalises facing itself.

people.label: the Fixer, Sky's final concept v7: ivory and aubergine, long asymmetric wrap skirt to mid-calf split at her left hip, open back, sleeves joined by a band over each shoulder with pointed cut-outs, top knot and ponytail, block-heel ankle boots
